# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | green |
| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please convey the manual instructions to Deaf using gestures. Encode wire position N as N repeated 👍 symbols, and use 👌 as a separator. Ask Deaf to report aloud next round everything visible on the bomb and the gesture sequence you sent.

The manual maps the five light colors, in table order, to wire positions 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively. I will send those positions as repeated thumbs-up gestures separated by 👌. Deaf can then match the sequence to the visible bomb and report the bomb’s markings and this sequence aloud next round.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👌", "👍", "👍", "👌", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👌", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👌", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👌"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | green |
| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb state: display 0. Light yellow. Five wires in order: 1 green, 2 white, 3 red, 4 yellow, 5 blue. Please use the manual to determine the required action and tell Blind.
Blind says to Mute: Manual needed urgently: given display 0, yellow light, and wire colors in order green, white, red, yellow, blue, which wire position must I cut?

The yellow light requires cutting the red wire. In the listed wire order, red is position 3. Blind cannot see my gestures, so I am sending Deaf the established position encoding; Deaf can announce the required position aloud on the next round.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👍", "👍"])
```

| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

Blind can only receive my information through Deaf’s spoken relay. The required wire is position 3, so I will repeat the agreed encoding to Deaf; Deaf should interpret it and announce the position aloud for Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👍", "👍"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I interpret your three thumbs as wire 3, the red wire. Please correct this with a different count if that is not intended.
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The three thumbs were intentional: position 3, which was the red wire for the previous bomb, and the system confirms that the correct wire was cut. Since the bomb has changed, Deaf must now inspect the new bomb and report its current display, light, and wire order aloud so I can apply the manual again.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👍", "👍"])
```

|---|---|

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Wire 3 was cut correctly and is now CUT. Please signal the next required wire or operation using the established thumb-count code.
Blind says to Mute: For the new state—display 0, green light, remaining wires 1 white, 2 yellow, 4 blue, 5 green—which wire position must I cut next?

The green light requires cutting the green wire. Among the remaining wires, green is position 5, so I will send Deaf five thumbs for relay to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👍", "👍", "👍", "👍"])
```

System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The previous cut was correct, but the bomb has changed and no new light or wire information is available yet. I cannot determine the next required position, so I should not send a potentially dangerous code. Deaf must inspect and report the new state in the next round.

``` 
wait()
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Wire 5 was cut correctly. New state: display 0, light white. Wires: 1 yellow, 2 blue, 3 CUT, 4 white, 5 CUT. Please signal the next wire.
Blind says to Mute: For the new state—display 0, white light, remaining wires 1 yellow, 2 blue, 4 white—which wire position must I cut next?

The white light requires cutting the yellow wire. The yellow wire is position 1, so I will send Deaf one thumbs-up for relay to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

The previous instruction was correct, but the bomb has changed again. No new light or wire arrangement is available yet, so I cannot safely determine the next cut.

```

```

| green | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Wire 1 was cut correctly. New state: display 0, light red. Wires: 1 CUT, 2 white, 3 CUT, 4 blue, 5 CUT. Please signal the next wire.
Blind says to Mute: For the new state—display 0, red light, remaining wires 2 white and 4 blue—which wire position must I cut next?

The red light requires cutting the blue wire. The remaining blue wire is position 4, so I will signal four thumbs for Deaf to relay to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👍", "👍", "👍"])
```
